payload.text: At the next fold, file a LOW issue for after the release (vc, 2026-11-01 17:35Z): gate_spans (tests/lib/test_helper.bash) starts a span on any non-comment line holding run_gate followed by a space, as a substring with no word boundary, so a name ending in run_gate (WP02c's unrun_gate was one, renamed unrun_entry) reads to 0087 and 0085 as a gate call.
